$comment: The First Voyage (docs/design/first-voyage.md): a new captain's first chapters, taught by the quartermaster. The cay a storm wrecked a sloop on lies 'cayTiles' (from, to) from the home port's berth, by sea, on water within 'shoreTiles' of land (of a cay, an island under 'islandTiles' tiles, where the home waters have one), and at least 'clearOfPortsTiles' from every port and haven (so Space there is the salvage, not a port); it is named for the home nation in 'cays'. She has reached it within 'arriveTiles' of the wreck.
